description: Inspect x402 v1/v2 challenges for spoofed stablecoins, decimal inflation, price mismatch, unsafe recipients and SSRF URLs. Pinned mainnet tokens on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and Solana. Returns all findings, nominal USD estimate and Ed25519 receipt. $0.002 (2000 atomic) Base USDC.

inputSchema.description: A raw x402 challenge or {challenge, advertised_price_usd?, micro_call?, openapi?}. Also accepts {headers, body?}, payment_required or www_authenticate. Supplied content only; URLs are never fetched.

accepts.description: Top-level x402 payment requirement offers array.

advertised_price_usd.description: Optional expected USD price for mismatch detection.

body.description: Optional HTTP 402 response body object or text.

challenge.description: Raw x402 v1/v2 challenge JSON object or base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED string.

micro_call.description: Assert a micro-call ceiling of $1.00 USD.

openapi.description: Optional JSON OpenAPI operation or document; never fetched.

x402Version.description: Top-level x402 protocol version (1 or 2) when passing a raw challenge object.

name: screen_x402_challenge
